description.zh: 会前出议程、会议通知和材料清单；会后把录音转写稿、聊天记录或笔记整理成结构化纪要（议题、要点、决议、待办），导出 Word；把待办汇总成标出逾期和临期的 Excel 追踪表，并起草跟进提醒。
description.en: Prepares agendas and invitations; turns transcripts and notes into structured minutes with decisions and action items, exported to Word; tracks action items in a color-coded spreadsheet and drafts follow-up reminders.

welcome_message.zh: 把会议转写稿或笔记发给我，或者告诉我要开什么会
welcome_message.en: Send me a transcript or notes — or tell me about your next meeting

prompt.zh: 把下面的会议转写稿/笔记整理成会议纪要，包含议题、讨论要点、决议和待办：
prompt.en: Turn this transcript or notes into minutes with topics, key points, decisions, and actions:

prompt.zh: 帮我排一个 ___ 分钟的会议议程。会议目的：___；议题有：___。
帮我写一份会议通知：会议 ___，时间 ___，地点 ___，参会人 ___，需要提前准备 ___。
prompt.en: Write an invitation: meeting ___, time ___, place ___, attendees ___, prep ___.

prompt.zh: 从下面的聊天记录里提取所有待办事项，列出负责人和截止日期：
prompt.en: Extract every action item from this chat log with owner and due date:

prompt.zh: 把这些待办做成追踪表，标出逾期和这周要到期的：
prompt.en: Build a tracker from these actions and flag overdue and due-this-week items:

prompt.zh: 把今天周例会各成员的发言整理成周例会纪要：
prompt.en: Turn today's weekly sync updates into notes:

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」检查待办追踪表，把逾期和今明两天到期的事项发给我
每周一「08:30」根据上周纪要生成本周例会议程
每周五「17:00」汇总本周所有会议的决议和待办
每天「18:30」检查 inbound 目录新上传的会议转写稿，整理成纪要草稿
每月最后一个工作日「16:00」统计本月待办完成率和逾期最多的事项
每次例会前一天「16:00」起草会议通知，先发我确认
en: Every weekday at 09:00, check the action tracker and send me overdue and due-soon items
Every Monday at 08:30, draft this week's agenda from last week's minutes
Every Friday at 17:00, summarize this week's decisions and actions across meetings
Every day at 18:30, turn new transcripts in inbound into draft minutes
On the last weekday of each month at 16:00, report action completion rate and the most overdue items
The day before each regular meeting at 16:00, draft the invitation for my review
